subject: Request: extended evaluation & additional credits for ClearWave integration
messages:
From: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@clearwavehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended evaluation & additional credits for ClearWave integration

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood's latency profile and the ability to test with real EHR payloads. We hit a snag on our side with the integration timeline: our security team needs to run an extended evaluation (they require more sample traffic and audit logs to validate KV cache behavior against our retention policy) and procurement has been slow due to a new vendor onboarding checklist.

Can Redwood provide a one-time extension of the POC and additional free credits beyond the standard PLG limits? Specifically: 
- Add 150,000 tokens of free evaluation credits
- Extend the POC window from 30 days to 75 days

We understand exceptions are rare; this is a regulated workflow (PHI-simulated data) and a successful POC would lead to a paid pilot and likely a multi-year deal (we're targeting a 7-figure ARR commit if the evaluation proves out). I've attached an updated SOW (clearwave-poc-sow-v2.pdf) and SOC2 checklist request (soc2-quick-reference.zip) to help surface what the security team needs.

Appreciate any flexibility you can offer — procurement wants to see if Redwood can support the extended runway before they escalate the vendor checklist.

Best,
Sophie Nguyen
Director of Integrations, ClearWave Health
Sophie.Nguyen@clearwavehealth.com

---attachment: clearwave-poc-sow-v2.pdf (application/pdf)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Sophie Nguyen <sophie@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extended evaluation & additional credits for ClearWave integration

Hi Sophie — thank you for the context and for sharing the SOW. I understand the procurement/security friction; healthcare evaluations often need a little extra runway.

A couple quick notes on Redwood's PLG policy: standard self-serve evaluations are 30 days + 50k free tokens. Exceptions are considered for strategic regulated accounts but require Deal Desk + Finance sign-off and a legal playbook (data handling controls and SOW/PO in place).

I will loop in our Deal Desk and Legal to request an approval. Can you confirm two items so I can present a clean ask: 
1) Is the data you'll send PHI or simulated/anonymized records?
2) Do you have a target procurement PO date or a point person I can include on the SOW signature path?

I'll escalate today and get back with a decision within 24 business hours.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 11:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: extended evaluation & additional credits for ClearWave integration

Team — forwarding ClearWave's request. Key context below: regulated healthcare prospect, potential funnel acceleration to a multi-year committed deal (they sign if security & integration validation completes). Procurement delays have pushed the evaluation timeline. Attachments included.

Their explicit ask: one-time extension to 75 days and +150k free tokens. They also implied they may request a first-year pricing concession if we require SOW/PO (they asked about discounting).

Why I think we should consider an exception: 
- Strategic account in our target healthcare segment with strong reference potential
- Engineering validated feasibility in demo; risk is mainly procurement/security timeline
- We can attach strict guardrails (one-off, non-recurring credits, documentation & PO required before extension applied).

Suggested recommendation for Deal Desk: Approve a capped concession with conditions: 
- Approve up to 150k evaluation tokens and a 45-day extension (total 75 days) as a one-time exception
- Conditioned on: signed SOW (DocuSign), documented PO or procurement acknowledgment, and SOC2 evidence intake completed by our security team
- No pricing commitments; any discount requires a separate commercial approval

Requested actions: 
1) Ben — can you estimate the unit cost impact of 150k tokens (ballpark) and whether an additional pricing ask is likely?
2) Aditya — can you provide exec/Deal Desk signoff authority for the one-off concession under the above guardrails?
3) Lauren — can Legal fast-track a short SOW addendum template and confirm language on non-recurring credits/termination?

Appreciate quick input — procurement is asking for our answer today so they can decide whether to push the onboarding checklist.

Thanks,
Vanessa

> Forwarded attachments: clearwave-poc-sow-v2.pdf, soc2-quick-reference.zip

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Jul 2026 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extended evaluation & additional credits for ClearWave integration

Vanessa / Ben / Lauren —

Thanks for the write-up and rationale. I approve a one-time concession for ClearWave with the following explicit conditions: 

1) Credit & extension: Approve 150,000 tokens of free evaluation credits and extend the POC to 60 days (not 75) from the original start date. The extra runway will be granted in a single tranche once the SOW is DocuSigned and a procurement acknowledgment/PO is received.

2) Guardrails: This is a non-recurring, one-off concession tied to Deal ID CW-3247. Any future extension or additional credits require a re-submittal to Deal Desk and Exec signoff.

3) Security/legal prerequisites: Lauren please confirm SOC2 intake and mark this as "limited access" until security attests. We will not enable production keys or long-term retention until security & Legal sign-off.

4) Commercial: No automatic pricing changes. If they request a first-year discount after POC, that will go through the standard discounting workflow — Sales to provide ARR forecast and Ben to model ROI impact.

Ben — estimate the short-term token cost and flag if the approved 150k materially impacts quotas. If it's high, we'll reduce to 100k and I will be notified before finalizing.

Please execute the DocuSign SOW flow and update HubSpot (link below) when the SOW is sent/returned. Once DocuSign + PO are in place, enable the credits and start the extended window.

Approved by,
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
